comment: Copy regions of scene10 (card #46's >80 KB picture) for docs/ROM_LAYOUT.md: [char0, 16-word chunk count] in descriptor order.  [0x100, 1024] is the 32 KiB tile set, [0x500, 640] the 160 sprite-pattern cells.  Read by tools/genviewer.py (viewer10) and renderer/pce-rom.js; the SAT has its fixed place in bank 1.
